preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 5.
For each test case, K must be a positive integer and less than or equal to the length of string S.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S)
preconditions.description: String S must consist only of lowercase English alphabet characters.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) == K for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line must have a length equal to K.

postconditions.expression: all(line == sorted(line) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line must be the lexicographically smallest subsequence of length K.
